svg.title: Heegaard surface atlas · genus 2
svg.desc: A sphere with 4 holes, joined by 2 annuli. Red alpha cores cross blue/green beta curves at the signed black points. Open points mark chart attachments. No projection crossings.
svg.text: The outside continues through ∞. Dashed circles attach to the annuli.
